en.title: Naomi Watts Honored at San Sebastián with Prestigious Donostia Award
en.summary: The acclaimed British actress Naomi Watts is set to receive a major career tribute at the 74th San Sebastián Film Festival. She will be honored with the festival's Donostia Award, celebrating her significant contributions to cinema.
en.body:
## San Sebastián Celebrates Naomi Watts's Cinematic Journey

The 74th San Sebastián Film Festival is gearing up to honor the remarkable career of British star **Naomi Watts**. She will be presented with the festival's prestigious Donostia Award, a significant accolade that celebrates a lifetime of achievement in film. This year, Watts joins the esteemed ranks of legendary figures who have previously received this honor, including the iconic German director **Werner Herzog**, whose own Donostia Award was announced earlier this month. Watts is slated to receive her award on Saturday, September 19th. In conjunction with this honor, she will also screen "The Housewife," the directorial debut from Canadian filmmaker **Ben Shirinian**, further cementing her connection to new cinematic voices.

Watts has consistently delivered compelling performances across a wide spectrum of genres throughout her career. From her early breakout roles in challenging independent films to her commanding presence in major studio productions, she has demonstrated a remarkable ability to inhabit complex characters with depth and nuance. Her filmography boasts collaborations with renowned directors and memorable turns in films that have resonated with audiences and critics alike. This award from San Sebastián is a testament to her enduring impact and artistic integrity within the global film community.

## A Beacon for Film Fans Worldwide

For fans of **Naomi Watts**, this recognition at San Sebastián is a cause for celebration. It underscores the profound connection she has forged with audiences through her diverse roles and unwavering commitment to her craft. Whether she's navigating the psychological depths of a thriller or bringing heartfelt emotion to a drama, Watts has a unique ability to captivate viewers. The San Sebastián Film Festival, known for its discerning eye and dedication to celebrating cinematic excellence, provides the perfect stage for this well-deserved tribute. Her presence at the festival, alongside the screening of a new directorial effort, offers fans a chance to engage with her work on multiple levels and anticipate her future projects.

## What's Next for the Acclaimed Actress

With the Donostia Award on the horizon, all eyes will be on **Naomi Watts** as she accepts this significant honor at San Sebastián. The festival runs from September 17th to September 25th, and her appearance on September 19th is a key date for attendees and fans following the event. The screening of "The Housewife" also offers a glimpse into her engagement with emerging talent and new directions in filmmaking. Details regarding other potential festival appearances or Q&A sessions for **Naomi Watts** have not yet been announced, but her presence alone is a major draw for the 74th edition.
